units.text: 关于贷款，建议遵循“先免费资金，后赚取资金，最后借贷资金”的原则。
units.reason: The context states 'Free money first (e.g., scholarships, grants); Earned money second (e.g., work-study); Borrowed money last (e.g., federal student loans)', which matches the principle.

units.text: 如果必须接受贷款，应优先选择条款最优惠的贷款，通常是指联邦学生贷款。
units.reason: The context says 'If you must accept loans, accept the ones with the most favorable terms and conditions. Usually, that means choosing the federal student loans offered to you.'

units.text: 请务必只借你需要的金额，并制定预算来帮助你确定借款数额。
units.reason: The context says 'Borrow only what you need!' and 'make a budget to help ensure you borrow only what you need.'

units.text: 如果你对援助通知中的贷款类型有疑问，请联系学校财务援助办公室。
units.reason: The context says 'If you have any questions or don't understand what types of loans are in your aid offer, contact the school.'

units.text: 请记住，如果你不接受全额贷款，之后可以增加金额。
units.reason: The context says 'Remember: If you don't accept the full amount of the loan you're eligible for, you can increase the amount later.'
